content_sections.heading: AIIMS Delhi Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the AIIMS Delhi Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download AIIMS Delhi Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies are available - 2 for Research Assistant (RA) and 2 for Field Investigator (FI).

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Research Assistant (RA): Post Graduation in Psychology/Social Work/Sociology/Anthropology with a minimum of 55% marks. Preference will be given to NET/MPhil/PhD candidates. Must have fluency in reading, writing, and speaking the Odiya language. Field Investigator (FI): Graduation in Psychology/Social Work/Sociology/Anthropology with a minimum of 55% marks. Preference will be given to candidates with a four-year graduation program. Must have fluency in reading, writing, and speaking the Odiya language.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: RA-Not more than 32 years (as on 15 Sept 2026) FI- Not more than 28 years (as on 15 Sept 2026) Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Online Application via Google Form Shortlisting Interview

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Delhi to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Research Assistant and Field Investigator posts is 07 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Assistant and Field Investigator posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies, with 2 for Research Assistant and 2 for Field Investigator.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Post Graduation in Psychology/Social Work/Sociology/Anthropology with a minimum of 55% marks is required for the Research Assistant position.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Field Investigator post will receive a salary of Rs. 20000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Does AIIMS Delhi offer age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Please refer to the official notification for details regarding age relaxation for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an online application, shortlisting of candidates, and an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is fluency in Odiya language a requirement for these posts?
faq.answer: Yes, fluency in reading, writing, and speaking the Odiya language is a mandatory requirement for both Research Assistant and Field Investigator posts.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is online, and candidates need to apply through the specified Google Form link.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for AIIMS Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is available in the "Important Links" section of this article.
